frames.title: Lesson 57 · Pseudo-cleft sentences — production and review

body: **Foco:** Pseudo-cleft sentences — produção e revisão.
**Verbos:** scrutinize.
**Expressões:** That is not to say that….
**Pronúncia:** Expressividade.
**22 palavras novas** (pesquisa).
**Texto do dia:** entrevista.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo produzir e revisar pseudo-clivadas numa entrevista, usando scrutinize e That is not to say that…

body: Esta aula treina **responder em frases completas (IELTS Speaking, TOEFL Speaking)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.intro: An editor talks about reviewing research.
qa: **What reviewers do is to scrutinize** methods, not just results. **All they ask for is** clarity. **That is not to say that** every flaw is fatal; **what matters is** whether conclusions follow from the data.
**What I would advise is** honesty about limits. **The reason why many papers are rejected is that** the claims outrun the evidence. **What authors forget is that** reviewers are readers too.

items.why: not to say that every flaw is fatal.

items.q: Papers are rejected when claims outrun evidence.

blocks.body: **That is not to say that…** introduz uma **ressalva** a algo que acabou de ser dito: “isso não quer dizer que…”.

items.s: What reviewers do ___ to scrutinize methods. (is)
That is not to say that every flaw ___ fatal. (is)
The reason why papers are rejected is ___ claims outrun evidence. (that)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

body: **That is not to say that…** — Isso não quer dizer que…
**To be fair,…** — Para ser justo,…
**Having said that,…** — Dito isso,…
**Be that as it may,…** — Seja como for,…
**Nonetheless,…** — Mesmo assim,…
**All the same,…** — Mesmo assim,…
**Fair enough.** — Justo.
**Take issue with…** — Discordar de…
**What do reviewers do?** — O que os revisores fazem?
**What they do is scrutinize the methods.** — O que fazem é examinar os métodos.
**Is every flaw fatal?** — Toda falha é fatal?
